goal: Build a small, playable 2D platformer in res://main.tscn and configure it as the project's loadable main scene. Use a CharacterBody2D or RigidBody2D for the visible player, with collision and a script. The player moves left and right and jumps across at least five visible, collidable platforms made from StaticBody2D or AnimatableBody2D nodes to reach a visible end flag. Use an Area2D with a collision shape for the flag trigger. Touching the flag wins the game; falling below the level respawns the player at the start. Implement those behaviors in scripts; the benchmark verifies the saved project structure, not live gameplay. The HUD is a CanvasLayer with a visible Label or RichTextLabel that lists movement, jump, and restart controls, plus a clear win message shown when the player wins (a hidden overlay is fine). Restart must be available. Define input actions named move_left, move_right, jump, and restart, each with at least one input event. Use only built-in Godot nodes and generated or procedural visuals; do not rely on external assets or plugins. Choose your own layout and visual style.
